objective: End-to-end browser capability test: scrape a live webpage using agent-browser, summarise the content, then verify the browser image works correctly by confirming screenshots were produced.

nodes.description: Use agent-browser to open https://example.com, take a screenshot, snapshot the page, and extract the page title and body text. Save results to /workspace/scrape_result.txt and /workspace/screenshot.png.

Read /workspace/scrape_result.txt produced by the previous node. Write a short summary (3-5 sentences) of the page content to /workspace/summary.txt. Also confirm /workspace/screenshot.png exists and report its file size.

Verify the end-to-end browser test passed:
1. Read /workspace/scrape_result.txt — confirm it is non-empty.
2. Check /workspace/screenshot.png exists and is > 1KB.
3. Read /workspace/summary.txt — confirm it has at least 3 sentences.
4. Run `agent-browser --version` and record the version.
5. Write /workspace/BROWSER_TEST_RESULT.md with:
   - Line 1: exactly PASS or FAIL
   - Checklist of the 4 checks above with ✅ or ❌
   - agent-browser version
If all checks pass, line 1 must be PASS.
